tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and sheet ground. Paper: BG_COLOR in render_floorplan.py. Arena: --bg in index.html.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels, cards, stat bars and footers sitting on surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card outlines. A line, never a text color.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and drawing linework on surface or panel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dimension notes, nav links, captions. 4.5:1 or better on surface and panel in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one loud color: Trojan red. Primary buttons, headings, key labels, the championship mat. Paper uses school red; arena uses the web neon red.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and shadowed red (DARK_RED in the 3D renders). Fills and borders only, not text on arena.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Section labels, badges and taglines on arena. On paper it is a gold fill only (gold on paper fails text contrast).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive or complete state; the green feature accent on the arena page.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Fourth feature accent on the arena page. Decoration only; never body text on paper.

tokens.name: school-red
tokens.usage: Fixed Hazel Green red for print, signage and the red logo. Does not change with theme.

tokens.name: school-black
tokens.usage: Fixed Hazel Green black: exterior walls, locker-room fills, the black logo.

tokens.name: plan-steel
tokens.usage: Steel structure, canopy, dimension strings and annotation text on plans (STEEL_GRAY).

tokens.name: plan-floor-dark
tokens.usage: Lobby floor and wall edge lines in plan and 3D renders.

tokens.name: plan-mat
tokens.usage: Practice wrestling mat fill under white labels (MAT_GRAY).

tokens.name: plan-roof
tokens.usage: Roof planes in the 3D perspective renders.

tokens.name: plan-arena-floor
tokens.usage: Arena floor field in the 2D plan (ARENA_FLOOR).

tokens.name: plan-light-gray
tokens.usage: Secondary labels on dark fills (area, SF) and light steel.

tokens.name: plan-tint-green
tokens.usage: Pale tint for circulation or accessible rooms in Phase 2 sheets (inferred from p2 scripts).

tokens.name: plan-tint-blue
tokens.usage: Pale tint for wet or service rooms in Phase 2 sheets (inferred from p2 scripts).

tokens.name: plan-tint-sand
tokens.usage: Pale tint for floor and program zones on Phase 2 sheets (inferred).

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Brick veneer in Phase 2 elevations (C dict in p2_c_101.py).

tokens.name: brick-light
tokens.usage: Light brick and mortar tone beside brick.

styles.name: arena-display
styles.usage: Hero h1. Set uppercase, color brand, with a glow. Source clamps 2rem to 4.5rem.

styles.name: arena-stat
styles.usage: Large figures in the stat bar.

styles.name: arena-label
styles.usage: Section labels written like // Core Features, and stat captions. Uppercase.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: Plan title on presentation renders (28 pt in the script, shown here as px at 96 dpi).

styles.name: sheet-stamp
styles.usage: PRELIMINARY stamp band, 17 pt bold, centered.

styles.name: sheet-number
styles.usage: Sheet number in the title block, 20 pt, shrinks to 10 pt to fit its cell.

styles.name: sheet-cell
styles.usage: Title-block values, 11.5 pt. Line pitch is 1.32 times size.

styles.name: sheet-zone
styles.usage: Room and zone names on the plan, 10 pt bold.

styles.name: sheet-note
styles.usage: Areas, cell labels and dimension notes, 7 pt.

styles.name: viewer-zone
styles.usage: Zone name in the hover info panel.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps; stat caption offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between feature cards, stat bar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter and button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sharp
tokens.usage: Arena web: buttons, cards, badges and panels are square. No rounding.

tokens.name: radius-glass
tokens.usage: Glass info panel in the 3D viewer only.

tokens.name: glow-brand
tokens.usage: Glow under primary buttons and brand headings on arena.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Peak of the pulsing accent badge.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under the 3D viewer's glass panel.

lineWeight.note: Linework weights in points, from the render and title-block scripts.

tokens.name: lw-exterior
tokens.usage: Building exterior wall outline on the floor plan.

tokens.name: lw-sheet-border
tokens.usage: Sheet border and title block outer frame.

tokens.name: lw-stamp-band
tokens.usage: Stamp band edges and the rule above the title block.

tokens.name: lw-cell
tokens.usage: Title-block cell dividers and placeholder boxes.

tokens.name: lw-detail
tokens.usage: Default drawing line and interior wall edge.

tokens.name: lw-hairline
tokens.usage: Photo-placeholder diagonals, tag outlines, key patches.
